title: ロボット材料力学
subtitle: Mechanics of Materials
educationalGoal:
Understand how force application to and deformation of a material is important as a basis of the structural design of machines and robots.
Learn step-by-step stress and strain and the deformation of stressed objects, truss structures, and beams by lecture and exercises.
Represent the inner stress caused by external forces as a mathematical model useful for design.
advice:
1. Students will use mathematical tools (matrix, vector, and differential equations) and physical tools (units, force, and moment). In this course, these tools are reviewed and supplemented. Students are expected to review mathematics and physics.
2. Students are expected to work hard on exercises during the class and review them afterward. Students are expected to complete all exercises.
3. Questions should not be left unsolved. Review of basic mathematics and physics is recommended.
books: Basis of Understanding Strength of Materials Second edition, Kyoritsu Syuppan (in Japanese)
requiredKnowledge:
Scientific calculator
Linear algebra (vector, matrix, and differential equations)

activityGoals.body: Draw a stress-strain graph and explain its characteristics and how it reflects deformation
Draw a shear force diagram (SFD) and bending moment diagram (BMD) to improve your understanding
Use load parameters to derive a differential equation of beam deflection
Solve a differential equation for beam deflection

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Explain stress and strain from the viewpoint of elastic mechanics.
(2) Design a safe structure using allowable stress and safety factors.
(3) Derive and solve differential equations of beam deflection.
(4) Design robotic structures while applying the mechanics of materials.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Calculate stress and strain.
(2) Draw SFDs and BMDs.
(3) Calculate thermal stress.
(4) Calculate deflection of beams using simple formulas
